title: LoomContentLifecycleOrganizationAndVersionParity
clause: Restore Loom block, document, organization, journal and version lifecycle semantics on SurrealDB.

current_source_discovery: Rediscover stable-main Loom block, folder, tag, pin, favorite, journal, overlay and version APIs/UI/tests.
Use MT-381 parity rows as the required behavior set and capture a RED proof for each broken semantic family.
stop_conditions: An existing behavior cannot be mapped to an authoritative Surreal record or relation.

scope.summary: Recover the everyday Loom content lifecycle that powers Handshake as an IDE and creative workspace: blocks, documents, hierarchy, organization, journals and history, all as project-qualified Surreal state.
acceptance_criteria: Block create/read/update/reorder/move/archive/restore/delete and version-conflict behavior is complete and atomic in SurrealDB.
Folders, tags, pins, favorites and typed hierarchy preserve deterministic ordering, uniqueness and project-qualified scope across restart.
Daily Journal and wiki-overlay lifecycle preserves canonical dates, time zones, source identity, revision lineage and tombstone semantics without creating duplicate documents.
Native UI exposes loading, empty, conflict, archived, restored and denied states with stable AccessKit and Argus identifiers.
Concurrent edits and retries are idempotent, retain recoverable history and never detach backlinks or domain projections silently.
proof_targets: Run focused Loom lifecycle tests against real embedded SurrealDB including restart and concurrent conflicts.
Run native UI interaction tests and Argus captures for organization and recovery states.
Run parity-matrix closure for all MT-385-owned rows.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private organization metadata and journal entries remain private inside a shared project.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: History, archive, favorites and ordering projections inherit source scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Open editors and cached lists close or requery after scope change.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Imported organization metadata receives explicit local ownership and scope.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Titles, dates, tags, counts, ordering gaps and conflict errors do not reveal denied content.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: content mutation, conflict, archive, restore and denial events
privacy-safe lifecycle, journal and ordering health
editor crash/freeze correlation and recovery handles

risk_if_missed: Loom remains technically stored in SurrealDB but loses the content workflows that make it useful across Handshake projects.

risks: Happy-path CRUD hides ordering or restart loss.
Journal creation duplicates a canonical note.
UI cache shows content after revocation.

sources: Official SurrealDB transaction and record-link documentation
research_provenance.selected_approach: Typed Surreal lifecycle records with deterministic organization, revision lineage and recoverable tombstones.
